title: The Wrong Train Ticket
transcript: Last month I bought a train ticket for Friday, when I needed to travel on Thursday. I only spotted the mistake on the bus to the station. At the ticket office, I expected to pay for a second ticket. The assistant explained that the company allowed changes before the date on the original ticket. She moved my booking to Thursday and charged a small fee. I made the train with two minutes to spare. Now I read my booking details aloud before paying.

questions.prompt: What mistake did the speaker make?
options: Buying a ticket for the wrong day.
questions.answer: Buying a ticket for the wrong day.
questions.explanation: 说话者本应周四出发，却买成了周五。

questions.prompt: How did the assistant deal with the booking?
options: She cancelled it and offered no refund.
She changed the date for a small fee.
She sold an entirely new ticket.
She let the speaker use it without changes.
questions.answer: She changed the date for a small fee.
questions.explanation: 售票员将预订改成周四，并收取少量费用。
